aj: CI red on main after merge 5e3d4b3. gpu-integration (matrix axis 3) failing. Can I rerun just the failing job without rebuilding docker images? What's the command? cc @maria

maria: Yep — easiest is GH UI: Actions -> open the workflow run -> Re-run jobs -> "Re-run failed jobs". That will skip image rebuilds.

maria: If you prefer CLI, use gh or our CI bot. Example commands:
```
# GH CLI: rerun the run and only failed jobs
gh run rerun 23456 --failed

# internal bot command (if you have perms)
/ci rerun --run 23456 --failed --no-image
```

ci-bot: heads-up: /ci rerun requires repo write perms. If you get permission denied, ping @eng-infra or use the GH UI.

sam: If it's the matrix axis, you can rerun just that job with gh by specifying the job id (see run's jobs list) or via bot:
```
/ci rerun --run 23456 --job-id job_789 --no-image
```

leo: quick sanity checks before rerun: check flaky checkpoint in the logs (search for "AssertionError"), confirm quotas (GPU pool), and look at recent infra deploys.

aj: Going to rerun via GH UI now — will update.

aj: rerun kicked (run 23457). If it flakes again, i'll open a bisect request and attach failing logs.

maria: If it recurs consistently in axis 3, do /bisect create --run 23457 --test gpu_integration and include the failing test id. We have an auto-bisect workflow that will try to narrow down the commit.

aj: Thanks all :thumbsup:
